subject: Private deployment architecture deep-dive — availability & scope
messages:
From: Susan Cho <susan.cho@terrahealth.com>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.k@terrahealth.com>, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment deep-dive — TerraHealth requirements (VPC / airgapped)

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our infra and security owners want a focused architecture deep-dive to validate VPC peering options, on-prem connectivity patterns, and air-gapped flows for a pilot environment. We need the session to cover:

- networking boundaries and NAT/egress controls
- key material handling (KMS/HSM integration options)
- audit/logging options and retention implications for Private
- deployment topology alternatives (dedicated GPU vs. colocated)

Our preferred window: week of Mar 29–Apr 2. We’re spread across PST (SF) and KST (Seoul) — core attendees would be myself, Alex (infra), and our security director (TBD). Can you propose a few 60–90 minute slots that accommodate a 2-hour timezone overlap (late morning PST / early morning KST)?

Attached: initial network diagram (high level) and our security questionnaire.

Best,
Susan
---
Susan Cho
Sr. Director IT, TerraHealth
susan.cho@terrahealth.com
+1 (415) 555-1289
From: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
To: Susan Cho <susan.cho@terrahealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment deep-dive — TerraHealth requirements (VPC / airgapped)

Hi Susan — thanks for the scope and the diagram, that’s perfect context. We’d like to run a 75-minute working session: 45 min architecture review + 30 min action items / next steps. Suggested slots (all PT):

- Tue Mar 30, 11:00–12:15 PT (20:00–21:15 KST)
- Wed Mar 31, 10:00–11:15 PT (19:00–20:15 KST)
- Thu Apr 1, 12:00–13:15 PT (21:00–22:15 KST)

Attendees from our side: me (platform/serving runtime), Monica Patel (private deployment lead), and Ben Carter (network/ops).

Pre-call asks so we’re efficient on the call:
- Can you confirm who will attend from security (name + email)?
- If possible, upload a VPC/subnet CIDR table and any firewall rules to the Drive link — we’ll annotate during the call.
- We prefer to discuss KMS key flow when we have an example ARN or HSM model; if that’s sensitive, a redacted example is fine.

I’ll put provisional invites on the three slots and we can finalize after you confirm availability.

Cheers,
Lukas

Lukas Meyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Quick note — the Wed Mar 31 slot collides with our weekly infra rotation. If we want maximum ops folks on the call (avoiding 3am KST odd-hours), prefer Tue Mar 30 11:00 PT. Also recommend we include a short pre-call checklist in the invite:

- VPN/Transit gateway point of contact + test account
- Temporary SSH bastion plan (yes/no)
- Sample KMS policy (redacted) if available
- Expected token retention window and log sinks

I attached our standard readiness checklist (lightweight) — we can tailor it for TerraHealth.

—Ben

From: Susan Cho <susan.cho@terrahealth.com>

Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 01:07:00 +0900

Thanks, Lukas and Ben — Tue Mar 30 11:00 PT works for us. Security director (Daniel Park, daniel.park@terrahealth.com) will join; Alex (infra) will be on the line as well. I uploaded a slightly more detailed CIDR table and a filled pre-call questionnaire (attached).

One question to flag for the agenda: we have a legacy on-prem HSM (Thales) — can Redwood describe supported HSM integrations and what keys must remain in-custody vs. proxy? If you can call that out in the architecture slides it’ll save time.

See you then — please send the final invite with agenda and the brief checklist Ben mentioned.

—Susan
